title: First Strand cDNA Synthesis Protocol
author: Sebastian ST Triesch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ze3f3gn

steps.title: Prepare reaction mixture on ice
steps.instruction: In a sterile, nuclease‑free tube kept on ice, add the following components in order: Template RNA (100 ng; range 1 pg–5 µg), Random Hexamer (1 µl, 100 pmol), dNTP Mix (1 µl, to achieve the final concentration indicated by the kit), and nuclease‑free water up to a total volume of 14.5 µl.

substeps.instruction: Add nuclease‑free water to bring volume to 14.5 µl.

steps.title: Optional GC‑rich RNA treatment
steps.instruction: If the RNA template is GC‑rich or known to form secondary structures, gently mix, briefly centrifuge, incubate at 65 °C for 5 min, then chill on ice, briefly centrifuge again, and keep the tube on ice.

steps.title: Mix and centrifuge reaction
steps.instruction: Gently mix the reaction mixture and briefly centrifuge the tube to collect contents at the bottom.

steps.title: Perform reverse transcription incubation
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a thermal cycler and run the following temperature program: 10 min at 25 °C, 30 min at 50 °C (increase to 65 °C for GC‑rich RNA), then 5 min at 85 °C.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 30 min at 50 °C (or 65 °C for GC‑rich RNA).

steps.title: Dilute cDNA and store
steps.instruction: Add 80 µl nuclease‑free water to the reaction, mix, and use the resulting cDNA directly in qPCR or store at –20 °C for up to one week.

substeps.instruction: Use directly in qPCR or store at –20 °C (≤1 week).
